Augustus III of Poland, who was also Elector of Saxony, bought Correggio's *Madonna of Saint George* (*Madonna with Saint George*) in 1746. It came from the Este collection in Modena, which Augustus III bought from for the Dresden royal collection. It now hangs in the Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister in Dresden. I'm answering from memory and haven't checked a source.

CONFIDENCE: 66
